content: {"summary":"Customers report frequent hardware failures, with many consoles failing within a year or even a month, causing frustration and distrust in product durability [tk_2311379][tk_288431][tk_2788958]. Service experiences are mixed; while some find support friendly, others face repeated repairs and poor communication, leading to repeated returns and extended downtime [tk_2244491][tk_1576156]. Shipping delays and missing items at pickup add to the negative perception, leaving buyers feeling abandoned and uncertain about future purchases [tk_632677][tk_2181457]."}
